text:
htons
Description
Convert the unsigned short integer from host byte order to network
byte order.
Syntax
htons
<
hostshort
>
htons <hostshort>
Convert the unsigned short integer from host byte order to network
byte order.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
set
hostshort
1234
set
netshort
[
htons
$hostshort
]
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
GLOBAL_GTM
